claims: Maintain norepinephrine infusion and titrate to keep MAP ≥65 mmHg given hypotension (systolic 79-87 mmHg).
Continue BiPap with current settings (IPAP 18, EPAP 13, O2 5 L/min) and monitor respiratory status and ABG.
Monitor arterial blood pressure closely and reassess hemodynamic status, given recent systolic pressures in the 70s-80s.
Recheck INR/PT and PTT and continue coagulation monitoring given INR 2.0-2.3 on warfarin with recent phytonadione administration.
Monitor serum creatinine and urine output for worsening renal function (creatinine 2.0-2.2 mg/dL, proteinuria).
Continue insulin therapy with fingerstick glucose monitoring given hyperglycemia (glucose 154-173 mg/dL).
Reassess and manage pain using CPOT-guided analgesia, continuing fentanyl as needed.
Monitor for delirium with CAM-ICU and implement non-pharmacologic delirium precautions given positive CAM-ICU.
Replete electrolytes as indicated (potassium 4.3-4.4 mEq/L, magnesium 1.8 mg/dL, phosphate 5.2 mg/dL) and recheck levels.
Perform skin assessment and pressure ulcer prevention given Braden score indicating risk and impaired skin findings.
